Backend: 7/7 pytest pass. Frontend: all data-testids render correctly with N=11 zero items at end of list and bulk-discard btn enabled.

PERSONAL_CATEGORIES.gastos_libres.subcategories === ['Entretenimiento', 'Compras personales', 'Suscripciones', 'Hobbies', 'Otros gastos'] (verified by code inspection at /app/frontend/src/constants/categories.js:27)

critical_code_review_comments: routes/gmail.py: _content_duplicate_exists is well-implemented — uses monto ±1% prefilter (Mongo $gte/$lte), then SequenceMatcher≥0.80 + fecha ±1día in Python. Caps cursor at 50 candidates which is sensible for performance.

routes/gmail.py /gmail/sync: helper is invoked at all 3 insert sites (recibo_servicio, parser-based, GPT-4o fallback) before insert_one — duplicados_omitidos is incremented and returned. Good consistency.
routes/gmail.py /gmail/dedup-cleanup: O(n^2) clustering is acceptable for typical user volumes (<1000 gmail_transactions). Filters out monto=0 / empty comercio / descartados upfront.

TabPorRevisar.jsx: Clean implementation. isZeroValue covers null and 0; sort is stable (keeps non-zero order). handleDiscardAllZero uses Promise.allSettled correctly and reports 'K de N descartados'. data-testid pattern review-discard-btn-{id} / review-zero-{id} / review-discard-zero-btn is consistent.

TabPorRevisar.jsx line 214: amount display `${(item.amount || 0).toFixed(2)}` correctly shows $0.00 for null. The 'Sin valor' badge gives the user the signal that this is data quality issue, not a real $0 transaction.

categories.js gastos_libres entry is correct and matches spec exactly. Note that 'Suscripciones' appears as both a top-level category (line 12-15) and a gastos_libres subcategory (line 27) — intentional but worth flagging in case of future budget bucket conflicts.
seed_data_creation: None — testing was read-only. The single-row PUT /gmail/transactions/{id}/discard mutation was NOT executed to avoid altering admin's real data; the button presence/enablement and aria-label were verified instead. The bulk discard would affect 11 zero-amount rows; main agent can verify by clicking the 'Descartar sin valor (11)' button directly in UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 features verified end-to-end. /app/backend/tests/test_iteration25_gmail_dedup.py is reusable as regression. Visual evidence in /app/.screenshots/iter25_revisar.png shows 17 review items including EL DOBLEZ x2 ($18.74/$12.69), CASADELI x1, AMOR ANIMAL x1, and 11 'Sin valor' rows at the bottom (Alerta de seguridad, Google, etc.). The discard button click flow (PUT /api/gmail/transactions/{id}/discard) was not exercised live to preserve user data — endpoint exists at routes/gmail.py:915 and was previously verified in earlier iterations.
